limits: Prototype links illustrate selected paths; this is not a running application.
System events, real text entry, media playback, request execution, networking, persistence and spending are not implemented by the prototype.
Future paid-mode amounts are example quote values, not a pricing decision or billing activation.
Code Connect mappings are deferred until the replacement components exist in application code.
Case mappings preserve the entire behavioral assertion; a screenshot does not prove a race, identity, security or billing invariant.
Prototype fields use fixed example text. Model and setting alternatives are component/state specifications; the prototype is a selected-journey review, not every possible parameter combination.
Timed transitions demonstrate one explicit successful response fixture. They do not qualify a provider or make unknown outcomes successful.
The desktop assembly and mobile export examples are separate saved-edit fixtures; they must not share mutable request state.

image_creation.contract: Assumes a signed-in creator. Choose an action, enter words, save, then submit. Completion resolves the exact pending input without submitting it or selecting the result in the viewer.

video_creation.contract: Assumes a signed-in creator. The accepted video request keeps its captured words and settings. A new empty draft remains empty when the video finishes. Viewing the result is explicit.

input_choice.contract: This is an existing project fixture. Browsing, searching and filtering do not change the current words, input or viewer. Choosing Desk v2 applies it; Escape or an outside click keeps the current input. An unavailable candidate does not turn the still-valid working input into an unavailable target.

assemble_export.contract: Existing project media: Stadium v1 is 4 seconds, Desk v2 inserts at 3 seconds, Stadium v2 is 4 seconds. Edit 5 is 11 seconds and exports as Export 1. Caption is attached to clip 1 at 1.0–3.5s; music begins at video time zero. Add audio opens a staged choice initialized from current Music, including when the one background track is occupied. Choosing a file or settings does not save; the final Add audio action replaces that single track in one revisioned command, while Cancel or closing leaves it unchanged. Copy audio remains unavailable while the background track is occupied. Closing an export panel keeps the job/file reachable.

mobile_creation.contract: Night run v1 is a separate generated image. The follow-up stays empty; opening the completed result is explicit.

mobile_media.contract: Inspecting Stadium v1 or v2 keeps the working draft. Version history is inspection, not an implicit Use as input action.

mobile_import.contract: A chosen file uploads to the existing project. Close leaves progress in the library. Saved media is visible before Use as input creates a separate edit and parks meaningful prior work.

mobile_export.contract: The mobile fixture is the separate 12-second edit 7, captured as Export 2. Fit and zoom do not change timing. Closing the sheet retains access to the same render and output.

catalogReconciliation.approval: Frame presence only; specific implementation targets require visual and interaction evidence.

screenRemoval20261016.policy: The October 16 pass deleted the request-context surfaces that showed the admission snapshot as UI: the Context panel ("Directions for this request" with the input version, earlier words and "Project instructions · version N"), its only screen C12, the "Inputs and directions" sheet with "Review directions" on C24, and a hidden note about copied directions on M08. Do not redraw them. The composer already shows the inputs and words a request will send; Reuse setup restores an earlier setup from the History menu, the viewer's Use menu and W37. The exact context stays an immutable backend snapshot. The Project menu's "Project instructions" item opened nothing and was removed too, so project instructions have no UI. Later the same day, the Download status component (idle, resolving, started, failed), its review board and E37 "Export download started" were deleted. Download hands the file to the browser, which shows the transfer, so the app draws no download status, and E36's Download button no longer links to another screen. The Dialog component was deleted too: it had no instances, its three kinds showed the same copy, and the leave guards (R04, B42, K18) draw their own dialogs. The same day the Clarification component lost its answering, proposal_ready, stale_proposal, applied and dismissed variants and its Review / Clarification board. Studio sends a chosen quick pick as the next message, so those lifecycle cards never appear; only the question card (now State=Default, used twice on C16) remains. Do not redraw them. Later on October 16 the Request status component (queued, running, succeeded, partial, failed), its Review / Request status board, its one screen use beside C09's result grid and C30's copied "2 ready · 1 failed · 1 still running" line were deleted. Each output slot already shows its own state (In the queue, Making your image, a ready result, or Could not make this image with Try again), and video requests keep their one-line status in conversation history, so the card only repeated the slots. Its Cancel and Cancel remaining buttons had no server route or UI control behind them, and View results pointed at results already on screen. The Project card component (local, creating, ready, load_failed, inaccessible, trashing, trashed) was deleted with it: no screen used it, and the server's project status is only active or trashed. Do not redraw them. Later on October 16, C16 ("Answer a specific question") and the Clarification component (its last variant, State=Default) were deleted. C16 showed the workspace answering "Use the second one." with image choices ("Which image should I change?"). The project workspace never asks a clarifying question, and Studio's first-turn clarify is a text question with quick-pick buttons, not an image chooser. Do not redraw them.

editSourceTileRedesign20261016.policy: An image edit's composer shows only the picture being edited. Compact input fills its 72 x 48 tile with the picture, has no caption (the Edit image button names the action) and keeps the Remove badge inside its top-right corner. Reference and Sketch, the two ways to give a request its picture, are not shown beside it; they return when the picture is removed, and the media picker the tile opens has Upload. Not ready shows a loader and Unavailable an alert on an empty tile, because neither state has a picture. An area edit shows one tile: the picture with its area.
